title: project.json
description: Successor to segments.json. Same flat array of narration scenes (index/text unchanged, so timing.py needs no changes), each now carrying a `visual` object that says how the scene is rendered: real footage, a manim diagram, a brief stick-figure beat, a still image, or a typographic text card.

index.description: 1-based scene order, same field assemble_video.py already reads to find NN.png.

text.description: Narration text for this scene, same field timing.py already uses for word-count/word-timing sync.

src.description: Path to a raw clip under footage/raw/, relative to the project dir.

out.description: Trim end, seconds into src. Must be > in.

confirmed.description: Optional. True once a human confirmed this clip/timestamp match. In fully-autonomous mode footage scenes render without it (assembler just warns); matching is normally avoided by using diagram/still/text-card/character scenes instead.

spec.description: Path to the diagram's declarative JSON spec (nodes/edges/labels/reveal order), relative to the project dir. Rendered by scripts/render_diagram.py into diagrams/<scene-id>.mp4.

Path to the character's declarative JSON spec (see schemas/character.schema.json: pose + duration), relative to the project dir. Rendered by scripts/render_character.py into characters/<scene-id>.mp4. A brief static beat, not a performing/gesturing character -- see scripts/render/character_scene.py.

src.description: Path to a still image, e.g. 03.png -- today's behavior via assemble_video.py's Ken Burns renderer, unchanged.

text.description: Bold typographic card text (e.g. a short comparison or definition), Pillow-rendered reusing gen_subtitles.py's tile/font helpers -- no manim needed.
